skills.description: Deterministic pricing and price-review preparation toolkit for defence manufacturers. Six calculations that turn a quote into a defensible file - cost build-up from material, purchased parts, labour, energy, tooling amortisation and overhead to a full cost, with a user-set period-expense ratio; price formation from cost base, profit rate and VAT; target-cost back-solve returning the allowable cost and the remaining gap; price-review variance with a breakdown check that reconciles item-level cuts against the total cut and flags hidden reductions; learning curve on cumulative output for staged price talks; and a contract-vehicle comparison (firm fixed price versus cost-plus with fee versus target-cost incentive with sharing and a settlement cap) across actual-cost scenarios so risk transfer is. Every ratio is a required input and nothing policy-related is pre-set. Pure standard library, 27 self-test assertions, Markdown memo to file; handle non-classified data only.
